title: Sintel's Injured Hand
description: Sintel's hand is bandaged and bleeding from the start. The wound matters because it is how Scales first reaches her.

title: Scales Lives With the Shaman
description: A baby dragon appears in the shaman's hut, comfortable around humans. It is not a wild creature.

title: The Shaman Hunts Dragons
description: The shaman teaches Sintel to kill, and his hut is filled with dragon trophies: a large scale, crystals, a dragon figurine.

title: The Map to the Dragon
description: The shaman gives Sintel a forged sword and points to a destination on a map labelled 'Dragon's' territory.

title: Scales Loves Sintel
description: Scales rests its head on Sintel's shoulder, plays with her, and mourns when she leaves. The bond is real.

title: A Baby-Dragon Image in the Lair
description: Inside the dragon's cave, a shadow-puppet vision of a baby dragon appears on the wall — as if the lair remembers its young.

title: The Dragon Recognizes Sintel
description: Mid-fight, the adult dragon stops, catches her blade, and looks at Sintel with unmistakable recognition.
